# rustinion_synthetic_check (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion synthetic (uptime) check: a single HTTP(S) or TCP request, a TLS certificate check (expiry and trust), a ping, a DNS lookup, or an ordered sequence of HTTP steps (check_type = "http_multistep"). See synthetic.rs in the main repo for execution semantics, including the SSRF protections a direct-mode check's target is checked against on every scheduled run (not at creation time — this provider does not pre-validate the target either, matching the server's own admin-UI behavior).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_type` (String) One of: http, tcp, tls (certificate expiry and trust for host[:port]), icmp (ping), dns, http_multistep.
- `group_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `cert_critical_days` (Number) tls and https checks: certificate_expiring becomes critical (sent right away) within this many days. Must not exceed cert_warning_days. Default 7.
- `cert_warning_days` (Number) tls and https checks: raise certificate_expiring (warning, summary email) when the certificate expires within this many days. 0 = only once expired. Default 30.
- `dns_record_type` (String) check_type = "dns" only: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS or TXT. Unset means A.
- `dns_server` (String) check_type = "dns" only: the DNS server to ask, an IP address with an optional port ("10.0.0.53", "10.0.0.53:5353"). Unset means a public resolver (1.1.1.1) for a direct check and the device's own resolver for a relay check. A direct check may only ask public servers and look up public names (single-label and .internal/.local/.lan/.home.arpa names, and answers with private addresses, are refused); use relay_mode = "relay" for internal ones.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expected_answer` (String) check_type = "dns" only: comma-separated values that must all be in the answer (for MX, "10 mx.example.com" or just "mx.example.com"). Unset means any non-empty answer passes.
- `expected_status_max` (Number)
- `expected_status_min` (Number)
- `failures_before_alert` (Number) Alert only after this many failed runs in a row, 1-10. Default 1 (the first failure).
- `http_method` (String)
- `interval_seconds` (Number)
- `location` (Block List) One of this check's own group's enrolled devices, relaying it from wherever that device actually is — not a hosted multi-region probe network, your own agents. Only meaningful for relay_mode = "relay". See min_failing_locations for the aggregation this activates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--location))
- `max_response_time_ms` (Number) Any check: a run slower than this many milliseconds counts as a failure. Unset means no limit.
- `min_failing_locations` (Number) How many of this check's own configured `location` blocks must be currently failing before it's considered down. 1 (the default) means any location failing is enough; set it to the full location count to require every location to agree. Meaningless until at least one `location` block exists — a check with none keeps the server's existing dynamic single-relay-device behavior, unaffected by this field.
- `relay_mode` (String) "direct" (the server makes the request itself) or "relay" (queued to an enrolled agent — required for endpoints only reachable inside the customer's own network). A check_type of "http_multistep" must use "direct" — relay mode isn't supported for multi-step checks.
- `step` (Block List) One HTTP step, in order. Only valid when check_type is "http_multistep"; the server rejects a non-empty step list on any other check_type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))
- `target` (String) Full URL for check_type = "http" (e.g. "https://example.com/health"), "host:port" for "tcp", "host" or "host:port" for "tls" (port 443 by default), a host name or IP for "icmp", the name to look up for "dns". Required unless check_type is "http_multistep", which the server always stores as the fixed placeholder "(multi-step)" regardless of what's sent here (a multi-step check's real target is its own ordered steps).
- `timeout_ms` (Number)
- `tls_verify` (Boolean) check_type = "tls": fail when the certificate isn't trusted or doesn't match the name. Set false for self-signed internal services (expiry is still checked). Default true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location`

Required:

- `device_id` (String) ID of a device in this check's own group_id.

Optional:

- `label` (String) A human-readable name for this location, e.g. "us-east-office".


<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `url` (String) May contain {{variable}} placeholders substituted from an earlier step's own capture in the same run.

Optional:

- `assert_body_regex` (String) Regex the response body must match, in addition to the status range.
- `assert_json_path` (String) Dotted path into the parsed JSON response body (e.g. "data.items.0.status"). Requires assert_json_value to also be set.
- `assert_json_value` (String) Expected value at assert_json_path. Requires assert_json_path to also be set.
- `body` (String)
- `capture_path` (String) The header name or JSON path to capture from, depending on capture_source.
- `capture_source` (String)
- `capture_variable` (String) Name to bind this step's captured value to, usable as {{name}} in any later step's url/headers/body. Requires capture_source and capture_path.
- `expected_status_max` (Number)
- `expected_status_min` (Number)
- `headers` (String) Request headers as a JSON object string, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer {{token}}"}. Defaults to {}.
- `method` (String)
